Company Overview - Altostrat 是媒体行业的知名企业，拥有大量的音频和视频内容，包括播客、访谈、新闻广播和纪录片。他们成功地向多样化的受众提供优质内容，这需要一个能够跟上动态媒体环境步伐的内容管理系统。Solution Concept - Altostrat 寻求利用 Google Cloud 的生成式 Al 来实现其内容管理和用户互动策略的现代化。他们想要一个能够通过个性化推荐、自然语言交互和无颖自助服务支持来赋能客户的平台。同时，他们希望通过动态定价、定向营销和个性化产品建议来推动收入增长。将 Al 驱动的工具无颖集成到现有的 Google Cloud 环境中，将使 Altostrat 能够高效地管理其庞大的媒体库，增强用户体验，并解锁新的收入来源。Google Cloud 的生成式 Al 将巩固他们在媒体行业的领导地位。Existing Technical Environment - Altostrat 的内容管理和交付平台利用 GKE 来实现可扩展性和高可用性，这对于处理其庞大的媒体库至关重要。他们涵盖各种文档、音频和视频格式的广泛媒体库存储在 Cloud Storage 中。为了获得关于用户行为、内容消费模式和受众人口统计数据的宝贵见解，Altostrat 利用 BigQuery 作为其主要数据仓库。此外，他们使用 Cloud Run functions 来无服务器执行事件驱动的任务，例如视频转码、元数据提取和个性化内容推荐。虽然 Altostrat 在云采用方面取得了重大进展，但他们仍保留了一些遗留的本地系统，用于特定的工作流，如内容摄取和归档。这些系统计划在不久的将来进行现代化改造并迁移到 Google Cloud。用户管理和身份验证目前通过 Google Identity 和第三方身份提供商的组合来处理。在监控和可观测性方面，Altostrat 依赖于原生 Google Cloud 工具 (如 Cloud Monitoring) 和开源解决方案 (如 Prometheus) 的混合使用，警报主要通过电子邮件通知发送。Business Requirements - “加速并增强所有环境中操作工作流的可靠性。[Google Cloud + 本地] + 简化基础设施管理以实现快速应用部署。* 在保持媒体内容的高可用性和可扩展性的同时，优化云存储成本。* 启用与平台的自然语言交互，并提供 24/7 用户支持。+ 自动生成媒体内容的简明摘要。+ 使用 NLP 和计算机视觉从媒体资产中提取丰富的元数据。“ 检测并过滤不当内容。+ 分析媒体内容以识别趋势并提取见解。+ 用数据为内容策略和决策提供信息。Technical Requirements - + 使用集中式管理平台对容器化部署的 CVCD 进行现代化改造。“ 用于数据摄取的安全、高性能混合云连接。+ 在本地和云端提供可扩展、高性能的 Kubernetes 环境。+ 针对不断增长的媒体量优化云存储成本。+ Rit Al 驱动的有害内容检测。* 确保 Al 系统是可审计的，并且其决策是可以解释的。+ 利用大语言模型 LLM) 和对话式 Al 来实现个性化体验和内容病毒式传播。*“ 开发具有自然语言理解能力的高级聊天机器人，以提供个性化协助。+ 针对多种媒体的自动摘要。Executive Statement - 在 Altostrat，我们正在拥抱人工智能的下一个前沿，以彻底变革我们的内容策略。通过利用生成式 Al 的力量，我们将通过为受众提供用于内容发现、个性化推荐和无颖交互的智能工具，创造无与伦比的用户体验。可靠性和成本管理是我们的首要任务。这一战略举措将加深参与度，培养客户忠诚度，并通过定向营销和定制内容产品解锁新的收入来源。我们预见未来 Al 驱动的创新将成为我们业务的核心，从而为公司带来更大的成功，并为客户提供卓越的价值。对于这个问题，请参考 Altostrat Media 案例研究。Altostrat 正在使用 Apigee 进行 AP 管理，并希望确保其 AP 免受过度使用和小用。你需要实施一项 Apigee 功能来控制 API 调用的总数以进行成本管理。你应该怎么做?

question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. KnightMotives has developed a new car configurator application to enhance both the dealer and customer experience. The new application will be deployed on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) KnightMotives wants you to replicate the deployment of the application across multiple locations to ensure this critical application is always available over the internet, even during regional outages. What should you do?

options.A: Create multiple GKE clusters in different regions. Deploy part of the microservices of the app in different clusters. Configure a multi-cluster Cloud Service Mesh.
options.B: Create multiple GKE clusters in different regions. Deploy the app on every cluster. Configure a multi-cluster Cloud Service Mesh.
options.C: Create a fleet of GKE clusters in different regions Deploy part of the microservices of the app in different clusters Configure a multi-cluster Gateway.
options.D: Create a fleet of GKE clusters in different regions. Deploy the app on every cluster. Configure a multi-cluster Gateway.

explanations.A: 错误: “Deploy part of the microservices” (部署部分微服务) : 这是致命错误。如果将微服务分散在不同区域，不仅会引入巨大的跨区域网络延迟，而且一旦某个区域发生中断，应用就会因为缺少关键服务而不可用，无法实现题目要求的"应对区域性中断"。Cloud Service Mesh: 虽然可以处理流量，但它主要侧重于服务间通信 (东西向流量)，对于构建面向互联网的全球多区域入口，Gateway 是更直接的工具。
explanations.B: 错误: “Deploy the app on every cluster": 这部分是正确的，全量复制是容灾的基础。“Configure a multi-cluster Cloud Service Mesh": 虽然 Service Mesh 也有 Ingress Gateway，但它的核心介值在于服务治理、mTLS 和可观测性。题目强调的是“通过互联网访问"和”“跨区域高可用"，Multi-cluster Gateway 是专门为此设计的 (它直接控制全球负载均衡器)，比 Service Mesh 更符合"入口流量管理"的场景。通常 service Mesh 会配合 Gateway 使用，但 Gateway 是处理入站流量的首选。选项错误: “Deploy part of the microservices": 同选项 A，拆分微服务无法满足区域级容灾要求。选项 D 正确: "Create a fleet": 启用 Fleet 是使用多集群功能 (如 MCG) 的前提。“Deploy the app on every cluster": 在每个区域的集群中部署完整的应用，确保任何一个区域宕机，其他区域都能独立承接流量，满足高可用性。“Configure a multi-cluster Gateway": 这是 GKE 提供的原生多集群入口控制器，它会自动配置 Google Cloud 的全球外部负载均衡器，将互联网流量智能路由到最近且健康的集群，完全符合题目需求。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Deploying only part of the microservices in each cluster means no single region can serve the whole application during a regional outage; the full app must run in every cluster to survive a regional failure.
explanations.D: 正确: "Create a fleet": 启用 Fleet 是使用多集群功能 (如 MCG) 的前提。“Deploy the app on every cluster": 在每个区域的集群中部署完整的应用，确保任何一个区域宕机，其他区域都能独立承接流量，满足高可用性。“Configure a multi-cluster Gateway": 这是 GKE 提供的原生多集群入口控制器，它会自动配置 Google Cloud 的全球外部负载均衡器，将互联网流量智能路由到最近且健康的集群，完全符合题目需求。

caseStudy: Company Overview - KnightMotives is a car manufacturer specializing in autonomous, self-driving vehicles, including Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs), hybrids and traditional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles. While KnightMotives has made strides with the in-vehicle experience in their BEV fleet, the hybrid and ICE vehicles have yet to implement these new systems and are viewed poorly by critics and drivers. The lack of modern in-vehicle technology in hybrid and ICE vehicles has resulted in declining sales and customer satisfaction. KnightMotives wants to modernize the consumer experience across all vehicles within five years Artificial Intelligence offers a unique opportunity to revolutionize the in-vehicle experience, as well as the shopping buying and service/maintenance experience. Investment in this new technology will require a shift in financial priorities on a global scale. KnightMotives also wants to improve their online ordering system, which is unreliable. Systems for customers to build their vehicle online for acquisition through a dealer are not delivering the data or reliability that dealers need, causing. A strain in the relationship between KnightMotives and dealers. Service technicians and sales staff need better tooling to enhance dealer successes, including built-to-order vehicles. Solution Concept - KnightMotives wants to shift from manufacturing cars to creating a complete and compelling “automotive experience.” Then strategy prioritizes delivering a consistent experience across all models, developing Al-powered features, generating new revenue from data monetization, adopting a digital focus to differentiate their brand from competitors, and developing better tools for mechanics and salespeople. Existing Technical Environment - KnightMotives's IT is largely on-premises with some applications on major cloud platforms. Their supply chain runs on an outdated mainframe, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) is also outdated, making new promotions and dealer discounts difficult to implement. Dealers have no budget for new equipment. There is fragmentation across vehicles with multiple code bases, and significant technical debt from supporting backwards compatibility. Network connectivity to manufacturing plants and vehicle connectivity in rural areas are challenges. Business Requirements - Key business requirements include fostering a personalized relationship with the driver and delivering a cohesive experience across all models. Creating a better build-to-order model will reduce time on the lot and provide transparency for both dealers and customers. Additionally, KnightMotives seeks to monetize corporate data to finance new technology investments, as their current Al infrastructure is obsolete and corporate data remains siloed. Security is a paramount concern due to past data breaches Adherence to European Union (EU) data protection regulations, especially for emerging autonomous platforms, is critical. KnightMotives plans to make significant investments in fully autonomous driving capabilities, with initial implementation targeting regions with favorable regulatory environments. Prioritizing employee upskilling, attracting top-tier talent, and fostering better communication between business and technical teams are also critical objectives. Technical Requirements - * Modernizing the in-vehicle experience includes developing a consistent user experience (UX) that seamlessly integrates Al- powered features across all models, updating in-vehicle hardware and software in legacy models to support new UX features and Al capabilities, and ensuring reliable network connectivity, especially in rural areas, to support real-time Al features and data transmission. + Network upgrades are necessary to support increased data traffic and improve connectivity between plants and headquarters. + IT infrastructure modernization requires adopting a hybrid cloud strategy to leverage the benefits of both on-premises and cloud infrastructure, and gradually modernizing or replacing legacy systems to improve efficiency and agility. + Autonomous vehicle development and testing requires investing in cutting-edge Al and machine learning technologies, building a robust simulation environment, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations related to autonomous vehicles. + Data monetization and insights requires implementing a robust data management platform, strict data security and privacy measures, and a scalable AI/ML infrastructure. + Increased focus on security and risk management involves implementing a comprehensive security framework to protect against cyber threats and data breaches, developing an incident response plan, and providing security awareness training to employees. + Providing a delightful experience for dealers and customers requires improving the online build-to-order system; developing modern dealer tools to streamline dealer operations, including sales, service, and inventory management; and implementing a comprehensive Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to track customer interactions personalize experiences, and improve customer satisfaction. Executive Statement - KnightMotives is committed to enhancing safety and saving lives by leveraging an extensive body of data 一 encompassing driving, road conditions, behavioral studies, and crash safety statistics — to create compelling digital experiences for drivers. Our Al consistently outperforms national safety statistics, ensuring the unique and coveted KnightMotives experience is aligned across all our vehicle models. Michael Knight, KnightMotives CEO Company Overview - KnightMotives 是一家专门生产自动驾驶汽车的汽车制造商，包括纯电动汽车 (BEV)、混合动力汽车和传统内燃机 (IC6) AZ. BBA KnightMotives 在其 BEV 车队的车内体验方面取得了长足进步，但混合动力和 ICE 汽车尚未实施这些新系统，并且受到评论家和轰驶员的差评。混合动力和 ICE 汽车缺乏现代车内技术导致销量和客户满意度下降。KnightMotives 希望在五年内实现所有车辆消费者体验的现代化。人工智能提供了一个独特的机会来彻底改变车内体验，以及购物购买和服务/维护体验。对这项新技术的投资将需要全球范围内的财务优先级转变。KnightMotives 还希望改进其不可靠的在线订购系统。客户在线配置车辆并通过经销商获取的系统无法提供经销商所需的数据或可靠性，导致 KnightMotives 与经销商之间的关系紧张。服务技术人员和销售人员需要更好的工具来提高经销商的成功率，包括按订单生产的车辆。Solution Concept - KnightMotives 希望从制造汽车转变为创造完整且引人入胜的"汽车体验"。该战略重点是提供跨所有车型的一致体验，开发人工智能驱动的功能，通过数据变现产生新收入，采用数字化重心以区别于竞争对手，并为机械师和销售人员开发更好的工具。Existing Technical Environment - KnightMotives 的 IT 主要位于本地，部分应用程序位于主要云平台上。他们的供应链运行在过时的大型机上，企业资源规划 (ERP) 也已过时，使得新的促销和经销商折扣难以实施。经销商没有预算购买新设备。车辆之间存在碎片化，有多个代码库，并且由于支持向后兼容性而存在巨大的技术债务。与制造工厂的网络连接以及农村地区的车辆连接都是挑战。Business Requirements - 关键业务需求包括建立与驾驶员的个性化关系，并提供跨所有车型的连贯体验。创建一个更好的按订单生产模式将减少车辆在停车场的停留时间，并为经销商和客户提供透明度。此外，KnightMotives 寻求将企业数据变现以资助新技术投资，因为他们目前的人工智能基础设施已过时，且企业数据仍然是孤立的。由于过去的数据泄露事件，安全性是首要关注点。遵守欧盟 (EU) 数据保护法规，特别是对于新兴的自动驾驶平台，至关重要。KnightMotives 计划在完全自动驾驶能力方面进行重大投资，初步实施将针对监管环境有利的地区。优先考虑员工技能提升，吸引项类人才，并促进业务和技术团队之间更好的沟通也是关键目标。Technical Requirements - * 现代化车内体验包括开发一致的用户体验 (UX)，将人工智能驱动的功能无颖集成到所有车型中，更新旧款车型的车内硬件和软件以支持新的 UX 功能和人工智能能力，并确保可靠的网络连接，特别是在农村地区，以支持实时人工智能功能和数据传输。+ 网络升级对于支持增加的数据流量和改善工厂与总部之间的连接是必要的。“IT 基础设施现代化需要采用混合云策略，以利用本地和云基础设施的优势，并逐步现代化或蔡换遗留系统以提高效率和敏捷性。* 自动驾驶汽车的开发和测试需要投资尖端的人工智能和机器学习技术，建立强大的模拟环境，并确保遵守与自动驾驶汽车相关的不断演变的法规。+ 数据变现和洞察需要实施强大的数据管理平台，严格的数据安全和隐私措施，以及可扩展的 AVML 基础设施。“加强对安全和风险管理的关注涉及实施全面的安全框架以防止网络威胁和数据泄露，制定事件响应计划，并向员工提供安全意识培训。* 为经销商和客户提供愉悦的体验需要改进在线按订单生产系统; 开发现代经销商工具以简化经销商运营，包括销售、服务和库存管理; 并实施全面的客户关系管理 (CRM) 系统以跟踪客户互动，个性化体验并提高客户满意度。Executive Statement - KnightMotives 致力于通过利用大量数据一一包括笔驶、路况、行为研究和碰撞安全统计数据一一来增强安全性并挽救生命，从而为驾驶员创造引人入胜的数字体验。我们的人工智能始终优于国家安全统计数据，确保独特且令人向往的 KnightMotives 体验在我们所有车型中保持一致。Michael Knight，KnightMotives 首席执行官针对这个问题，请参考 KnightMotives 汽车案例研究。KnightMotives 开发了一个新的汽车配置器应用程序，以增强经销商和客户的体验。新应用程序将部署在 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 上。KnightMotives 希望你在多个地点复制该应用程序的部署，以确保即使在区域性中断期间，这个关键应用程序也能始终通过互联网访问。你应该怎么做?

question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. As part of its development of fully autonomous driving vehicles, KnightMotives wants to analyze all vehicle sensor data during test drives. The analysis will enable KnightMotives to improve its software based on insights from this d ata. Different event types, such as parking, overtaking and navigating, need to be analyzed. Each test vehicle and event type has an ID. Different categories of sensors, such as cameras, radars, and ultrasonic beams, also need to be analyzed. During each a utonomously - initiated event, data from multiple sensors will be captured and sent to Google Cloud where the data will be stored in Bigtable. During data analysis, you want to be able to retrieve all sensor data of occurrences of the same event type for a s pecific vehicle within a specific interval of time. You need to design a Bigtable schema that is optimized for read performance. What should you do?

options.A: Use the sensor category, event ID, and timestamp(in that order) as the row key. Create a column family for each individual sensor and a column qualifier for each vehicle.
options.B: Use the timestamp, vehicle ID, and event ID(in that order) as the row key. Create a column family per sensor category, and use a column qualifier for each individual sensor within its respective category.
options.C: Use the vehicle ID and event ID(in that order) as the row key. Create a column family per sensor category, and C use a column qualifier for each individual sensor within its respective category. Utilize the timestamped versions of a cell to distinguish between different moments in time of similar events.
options.D: Use the vehicle ID, event ID, and timestamp in that order) as the row key. Create a column family per sensor category, and use a column qualifier for each individual sensor within its respective category. •

explanations.A: Incorrect. Leading the row key with sensor category groups data by sensor rather than by vehicle, so retrieving all sensors for a specific vehicle and event type within a time range would require scattered scans instead of one contiguous range.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Starting the row key with a timestamp causes hotspotting, because all recent writes hit the same row-key range, and it does not let you efficiently retrieve rows for a specific vehicle and event type.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Relying on cell version timestamps to represent different event occurrences is a Bigtable anti-pattern; time should be part of the row key so a time-range scan works, and versioned cells are not meant to store distinct events.
explanations.D: Correct. Placing vehicle ID, then event ID, then timestamp in the row key makes all occurrences of the same event type for a given vehicle contiguous and ordered by time, so a time-range scan is a single efficient read optimized for the query pattern.

question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study, KnightMotives has deployed their new Dealer Tools on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). You are supporting KnightMotives in the performance of the GKE workloads. Some of the Pods are Statefull. To ensure these Pods do not consume an unlimited amount of CPU, you have configured resource limits on the Deployments. You have identified that these Pods were allocated too much CPU and are actually consuming drastically less some of the time. You want to optimize resource usage and allow maximum flexibility in case of higher load. What should you do?

options.A: Configure resource requests per Deployment. Set resource requests slightly above the typical CPU usage observed during monitoring.
options.B: Configure resource requests per Deployment. Ensure the requests are equal to the current limits.
options.C: Enable vertical Pod autoscaling on each Deployment. Ensure the autoscaling mode is set to Auto. TE Deployment
options.D: Enable horizontal Pod autoscaling on each Deployment. Ensure the minimum number of Pods is lower than the currently configured amount in the Deployment. TE Deployment

explanations.A: Configure resource requests per Deployment. Set resource requests slightly above the typical CPU usage observed during monitoring. (为每个 Deployment 配置资源请求。将资源请求设置为略高于监控期间观察到的典型 CPU 使用率。) 正确。IB ‘Requests 设置为略高于“典型使用率"，我们减少了不必要的资源预留 (解决了"allocated too much'的问题)，从而优化了集群的资源分配效率。由于题目暗示已经配置了较高的Limits”(为了防止无限消耗但允许一定范围)，降低 ‘Requests’ SHA ‘Requests’ 和 ‘Limits’ 之间的差距，创建了一个 *Burstable (可突发)* 的 QoS 类型。这允许 Pod 在负载增加时，利用节点上的空闲 CPU 突发到 Limit 上限，满足了“最大灵活性"的要求。
explanations.B: Configure resource requests per Deployment. Ensure the requests are equal to the current limits. (为每个 Deployment 配置资源请求。确保请求等于当前的限制。) 错误。设置 "Requests == Limits’ 会创建 *Guaranteed (有保证)** 的 Qos 类型。虽然这提供了性能保证，但它要求预留最大峰值的资源。既然题目指出 Pod 经常消耗得很少，这样做会永久锁定大量未使用的资源，无法实现"优化资源使用"的目标，也缺乏利用空闲资源的灵活性。
explanations.C: Enable vertical Pod autoscaling on each Deployment. Ensure the autoscaling mode is set to Auto. (在每个 Deployment 上启用垂直 Pod 自动扩缩。确保自动扩缩模式设置为 Auto。) 错误。虽然 VPA 可以自动调整 Requests，但题目提到部分 Pod **Stateful (有状态的)”*。VPA 在 ‘Auto’ 模式下调整资源时需要”重启 Pod*。对于有状态应用，频繁或不可预测的重启可能会导致服务中断、数据恢复时间长或不稳定性。此外，VPA 可能会根据历史数据同时降低 Limits，这可能会限制应对突发高负载的"最大灵活性"。手动调整 Requests 为 Burstable 模式通常是处理有状态负载更安全、更可控的方法。
explanations.D: Enable horizontal Pod autoscaling on each Deployment. Ensure the minimum number of Pods is lower than the currently configured amount in the Deployment. caseStudy: Company Overview - KnightMotives is a car manufacturer specializing in autonomous, self-driving vehicles, including Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs), hybrids and traditional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles. While KnightMotives has made strides with the in-vehicle experience in their BEV fleet, the hybrid and ICE vehicles have yet to implement these new systems and are viewed poorly by critics and drivers. The lack of modern in-vehicle technology in hybrid and ICE vehicles has resulted in declining sales and customer satisfaction. KnightMotives wants to modernize the consumer experience across all vehicles within five years Artificial Intelligence offers a unique opportunity to revolutionize the in-vehicle experience, as well as the shopping buying and service/maintenance experience. Investment in this new technology will require a shift in financial priorities on a global scale. KnightMotives also wants to improve their online ordering system, which is unreliable. Systems for customers to build their vehicle online for acquisition through a dealer are not delivering the data or reliability that dealers need, causing. A strain in the relationship between KnightMotives and dealers. Service technicians and sales staff need better tooling to enhance dealer successes, including built-to-order vehicles. Solution Concept - KnightMotives wants to shift from manufacturing cars to creating a complete and compelling “automotive experience.” Then strategy prioritizes delivering a consistent experience across all models, developing Al-powered features, generating new revenue from data monetization, adopting a digital focus to differentiate their brand from competitors, and developing better tools for mechanics and salespeople. Existing Technical Environment - KnightMotives's IT is largely on-premises with some applications on major cloud platforms. Their supply chain runs on an outdated mainframe, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) is also outdated, making new promotions and dealer discounts difficult to implement. Dealers have no budget for new equipment. There is fragmentation across vehicles with multiple code bases, and significant technical debt from supporting backwards compatibility. Network connectivity to manufacturing plants and vehicle connectivity in rural areas are challenges. Business Requirements - Key business requirements include fostering a personalized relationship with the driver and delivering a cohesive experience across all models. Creating a better build-to-order model will reduce time on the lot and provide transparency for both dealers and customers. Additionally, KnightMotives seeks to monetize corporate data to finance new technology investments, as their current Al infrastructure is obsolete and corporate data remains siloed. Security is a paramount concern due to past data breaches Adherence to European Union (EU) data protection regulations, especially for emerging autonomous platforms, is critical. KnightMotives plans to make significant investments in fully autonomous driving capabilities, with initial implementation targeting regions with favorable regulatory environments. Prioritizing employee upskilling, attracting top-tier talent, and fostering better communication between business and technical teams are also critical objectives. Technical Requirements - * Modernizing the in-vehicle experience includes developing a consistent user experience (UX) that seamlessly integrates Al- powered features across all models, updating in-vehicle hardware and software in legacy models to support new UX features and Al capabilities, and ensuring reliable network connectivity, especially in rural areas, to support real-time Al features and data transmission. + Network upgrades are necessary to support increased data traffic and improve connectivity between plants and headquarters. + IT infrastructure modernization requires adopting a hybrid cloud strategy to leverage the benefits of both on-premises and cloud infrastructure, and gradually modernizing or replacing legacy systems to improve efficiency and agility. + Autonomous vehicle development and testing requires investing in cutting-edge Al and machine learning technologies, building a robust simulation environment, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations related to autonomous vehicles. + Data monetization and insights requires implementing a robust data management platform, strict data security and privacy measures, and a scalable AI/ML infrastructure. + Increased focus on security and risk management involves implementing a comprehensive security framework to protect against cyber threats and data breaches, developing an incident response plan, and providing security awareness training to employees. + Providing a delightful experience for dealers and customers requires improving the online build-to-order system; developing modern dealer tools to streamline dealer operations, including sales, service, and inventory management; and implementing a comprehensive Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to track customer interactions personalize experiences, and improve customer satisfaction. Executive Statement - KnightMotives is committed to enhancing safety and saving lives by leveraging an extensive body of data 一 encompassing driving, road conditions, behavioral studies, and crash safety statistics — to create compelling digital experiences for drivers. Our Al consistently outperforms national safety statistics, ensuring the unique and coveted KnightMotives experience is aligned across all our vehicle models. Michael Knight, KnightMotives CEO Company Overview - KnightMotives 是一家专门生产自动驾驶汽车的汽车制造商，包括纯电动汽车 (BEV)、混合动力汽车和传统内燃机 (ICE) 汽车。虽然 KnightMotives 在其 BEV 车队的车内体验方面取得了长足进步，但混合动力和 ICE 汽车尚未实施这些新系统，并且受到评论家和轰驶员的差评。混合动力和 ICE 汽车缺乏现代车内技术导致销量和客户满意度下降。KnightMotives 希望在五年内实现所有车辆消费者体验的现代化。人工智能提供了一个独特的机会来彻底改变车内体验，以及购物、购买和维修/保养体验。对这项新技术的投资将需要全球范围内的财务重点转移。KnightMotives 还希望改进其不可靠的在线订购系统。客户在线选配车辆并通过经销商获取的系统无法提供经销商所需的数据或可 att, SB KnightMotives 与经销商之间的关系紧张。维修技师和销售人员需要更好的工具来提高经销商的成功率，包括按订单生产的车辆。Solution Concept - KnightMotives 希望从制造汽车转变为创造完整且引人入胜的"汽车体验"。该战略优先考虑在所有车型中提供一致的体验，开发人工智能驱动的功能，通过数据变现产生新的收入，采用数字化重心以区别于竞争对手，并为机械师和销售人员开发更好的工具。Existing Technical Environment - KnightMotives 的 IT 主要位于本地，部分应用程序位于主要云平台上。他们的供应链运行在过时的大型机上，企业资源规划 (ERP) 也已过时，使得新的促销和经销商折扣难以实施。经销商没有预算购买新设备。车辆之问存在碎片化，拥有多个代码库，并且由于支持向后兼容性而存在巨大的技术债务。制造工厂的网络连接和农村地区的车辆连接都是挑战。Business Requirements - 关键业务需求包括建立与驾驶员的个性化关系，并在所有车型中提供具有凝聚力的体验。创建一个更好的按订单生产模式将减少车辆在停车场的停留时间，并为经销商和客户提供透明度。此外，KnightMotives 寻求将企业数据变现以资助新技术投资，因为他们当前的人工智能基础设施已过时，且企业数据仍然处于孤岛状态。由于过去的数据泄露事件，安全性是首要关注点。遵守欧盟 (EU) 数据保护法规，特别是对于新兴的自动驾驶平台，至关重要。KnightMotives 计划在完全自动驾驶能力方面进行重大投资，初步实施将针对监管环境有利的地区。优先考虑员工技能提升，吸引顶尖人才，并促进业务团队与技术团队之间更好的沟通也是关键目标。Technical Requirements - * 现代化车内体验包括开发一致的用户体验 (UX)，将人工智能驱动的功能无颖集成到所有车型中，更新旧款车型的车内硬件和软件以支持新的 UX 功能和人工智能能力，并确保可靠的网络连接，特别是在农村地区，以支持实时人工智能功能和数据传输。+ 网络升级对于支持增加的数据流量和改善工厂与总部之间的连接是必要的。“IT 基础设施现代化需要采用混合云策略，以利用本地和云基础设施的优势，并逐步现代化或更换遗留系统以提高效率和敏捷性。* 自动驾驶汽车的开发和测试需要投资尖端的人工智能和机器学习技术，建立强大的模拟环境，并确保遵守与自动驾驶汽车相关的不断演变的法规。+ 数据变现和洞察需要实施强大的数据管理平台，严格的数据安全和隐私措施，以及可扩展的 AVML 基础设施。“加强对安全和风险管理的关注涉及实施全面的安全框架以防止网络威胁和数据泄露，制定事件响应计划，并向员工提供安全意识培训。* 为经销商和客户提供愉悦的体验需要改进在线按订单生产系统; 开发现代经销商工具以简化经销商运营，包括销售、服务和库存管理; 并实施全面的客户关系管理 (CRM) 系统以跟踪客户互动，个性化体验并提高客户满意度。Executive Statement - KnightMotives 致力于通过利用大量数据一一包括笔驶、路况、行为研究和碰撞安全统计数据一一来增强安全性和挽救生命，从而为驾驶员创造引人入胜的数字体验。我们的人工智能始终优于国家安全统计数据，确保独特且令人垂泗的 KnightMotives 体验在我们所有车型中保持一致。Michael Knight，KnightMotives 首席执行官针对这个问题，请参考 KnightMotives 汽车案例研究，KnightMotives 已在 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 上部署了他们的新经销商工具。您正在支持 KnightMotives 处理 GKE 工作负载的性能。其中一些 Pod 是有状态的 (Stateful)。为了确保这些 Pod 不会消耗无限量的 CPU，您已经在 Deployment 上配置了资源限制 (resource limits), 您发现这些 Pod 被分配了过多的 CPU，而实际上有些时候消耗的 CPU 极少。您希望优化资源使用，并在负载较高的情况下允许最大的灵活性。您应该怎么做?

question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. KnightMotives has established a dedicated Google Cloud Interconnect with 99.99% availability between its headquarters and two different metropolitan areas corresponding to the us-central1 and us-east1 Google Cloud regions. To minimize cost and latency between these workloads, you want to ensure all workloads in Google Cloud are deployed in these two regions as the VLAN attachment for the Cloud Interconnect. What should you do?

options.A: Schedule an export of all assets via Asset Inventory into BigQuery. Schedule a daily Cloud Run function to query the export and send out an alert if resources are created in regions outside of the allowed list.
options.B: Ensure all deployments are done through Infrastructure as Code using standardized Terraform modules. Configure the region variable of all resources with a default value corresponding to one of the allowed regions.
options.C: Configure the Resource Location Restriction constraint organization policy at the organization level, and ensure it allows only the two allowed regions.
options.D: Limit the Google Cloud VPC used by the Cloud Interconnect to only have subnets in the allowed regions.

explanations.A: Incorrect. An Asset Inventory export with a daily alerting job only detects out-of-region resources after they are created; it is reactive and does not prevent deployment in disallowed regions.
explanations.B: Incorrect. A Terraform default region variable can be overridden and only guides deployments made through that Terraform; it does not enforce the location restriction across all methods of resource creation.
explanations.C: Correct. The Resource Location Restriction organization policy constraint proactively prevents resources from being created in any region other than the two allowed ones, enforced across the entire organization.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Restricting VPC subnets only affects resources that use that VPC; many resources such as Cloud Storage, BigQuery, or VMs in other networks are not constrained by subnet placement, so it does not enforce the location policy.

question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. KnightMotives is managing supplier data and pricing in a central MySQL database at headquarters(HQ). Only personnel at HQ are allowed to change the data. Each local plant stores a copy of the data in their own MySQL database, often using a different database schema or version. Every night a batch job exports any product or price updates in XML format from the central database at HQ and stores the updated data on a central FTP server. Each local plant must download this XML file and update their local system with the new information. The local data kept by some plants has become inconsistent with the source data due to XML parsing issues. HQ wants to easily verify that all changes are applied correctly at each plant.

options.A: Create a Pub/Sub topic per supplier, and have HQ publish all changes related to the respective supplier in JSON format on that topic. Allow all plants to create a Pub/Sub Pull subscription to receive messages for their suppliers and update their databas es.
options.B: Create a Pub/Sub topic per supplier, and have HQ publish all changes related to the respective supplier in JSON format on that topic. Allow all plants to create a Pub/Sub Push subscription to receive messages for their suppliers and update their databas es.
options.C: Migrate the self - hosted MySQL database at HQ to Cloud SQL. Standardize the database schema across all plants, and configure the local databases as external read replicas in Cloud SQL.
options.D: Migrate the self - hosted MySQL database at HQ to Cloud SQL. Configure Database Migration Service between Cloud SQL and the on - premises databases. When creating the migration job, choose continuous migration instead of one - time migration. •

explanations.A: Incorrect. Moving to a per-supplier Pub/Sub topic with a pull subscription still requires each plant to parse messages and update its own differently-structured database, so it does not guarantee consistency or let HQ verify changes were applied correctly.
explanations.B: Incorrect. As with the pull approach, a push subscription still leaves each plant independently applying updates to divergent schemas, so the parsing and consistency problems and the lack of central verification remain.
explanations.C: Correct. Migrating HQ to Cloud SQL, standardizing the schema, and configuring each plant as an external read replica means updates propagate automatically and identically, eliminating XML parsing errors and giving HQ a single consistent source of truth.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Database Migration Service is designed to migrate databases into Cloud SQL, not to continuously push HQ changes out to many heterogeneous on-premises plant databases, so it does not fit this ongoing replication and verification need.

question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. KnightMotives wants to personalize the dealer experience for its customers and has decided to train its own Al models for personalized recommendations. The company will start collecting personally identifiable information (PII) from its customers to use as part of the models’ training data. KnightMotives wants to ensure maximum security and compliance worldwide. You need to ensure the data is encrypted both at rest and during Al model training without impacting the models’ accuracy. What should you do?

options.A: Store the training data in BigQuery using column-level encryption. Train the model using Confidential GKE Nodes.
options.B: Store the training data in BigQuery using column-level encryption. Train the model on VertexAI notebooks using customer-managed encryption keys.
options.C: Process all data with Sensitive Data Protection's de-identification service. Replace any Pll with a random string before storing it. Train the model using Confidential GKE Nodes.
options.D: Process all data with Sensitive Data Protection's de-identification service. Replace any Pll with a random string before storing it. Train the model on VertexAl notebooks using customer-managed encryption keys.

explanations.A: 将训练数据使用列级加密存储在 BigQuery 中。使用机密 GKE 节点 (Confidential GKE Nodes) 训练模型。正确。存储: BigQuery 列级加密提供了细粒度的静态数据保护，适合 Pll。训练: Confidential GKE Nodes 提供了"使用中加密 (Encryption in use) ”的能力。数据在内存中处理时保持加密状态，只有 CPU 内部才能访问明文，满足了“训练期间加密"的要求。准确性: ”因为是在受信任的执行环境 (TEE) 中处理原始数据，模型可以访问完整信息，不会因数据变形而降低准确性。
explanations.B: 将训练数据使用列级加密存储在 BigQuery 中。使用客户管理的加密密钥在 Vertex Al Notebooks 上训练模型。错误。虽然 CMEK (客户管理的加密密钥) 增强了静态数据的安全性，但它不能保护正在使用中的数据 (内存中的数据)。当数据加载到 Notebook 的内存中进行训练时，它是明文的。这不满足"在 Al 模型训练期间加密"的要求。5. 使用敏感数据保护 (Sensitive Data Protection) 的去标识化服务处理所有数据。在存储之前将任何 Pll 替换为随机字符串。使用机密 GKE 节点 (Confidential GKE Nodes) 训练模型。错误。题目要求的是"加密'数据，而不是“去标识化"或"屏蔽数据。虽然去标识化是保护隐私的好方法，但题目明确要求"不影响模型准确性"。如果 Pll 数据本身包含对个性化推荐有用的特征 (不仅仅是ID)，替换为随机字符串可能会破坏数据特征，从而影响准确性。更重要的是，题目强调的是加密机制，Option A 是针对“加密使用中数据'最直接的技术响应。D. 使用敏感数据保护 (Sensitive Data Protection) 的去标识化服务处理所有数据。在存储之前将任何 Pll 替换为随机字符串。使用客户管理的加密密钥在 Vertex Al Notebooks 上训练模型。错误。同选项 B，CMEK 无法实现”训练期间 (AH) “的加密。同选项 C，去标识化可能不符合题目对于保持数据完整性以确保准确性的隐含要求，且未通过技术手段实现"使用中加密"“。我的选择 A BASE A 比较与结论我的分析与官方答案一致。核心在于识别出题目对 Encryption in Use (使用中加密) 的需求，这是 Confidential Computing (WH 计算/机密节点) 的典型应用场景。只有选项 A 提供了在模型训练计算过程中保护内存数据的方案。sys、| fie Ge cee 0 oo Bibenusih yeoman

A strain in the relationship between KnightMotives and dealers. Service technicians and sales staff need better tooling to enhance dealer successes, including built-to-order vehicles. Existing Technical Environment - KnightMotives's IT is largely on-premises with some applications on major cloud platforms. Their supply chain runs on an outdated mainframe, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) is also outdated, making new promotions and dealer discounts difficult to implement. Dealers have no budget for new equipment. There is fragmentation across vehicles with multiple code bases, and significant technical debt from supporting backwards compatibility. Network connectivity to manufacturing plants and vehicle connectivity in rural areas are challenges. Business Requirements - Key business requirements include fostering a personalized relationship with the driver and delivering a cohesive experience across all models. Creating a better build-to-order model will reduce time on the lot and provide transparency for both dealers and customers. Additionally, KnightMotives seeks to monetize corporate data to finance new technology investments, as their current Al infrastructure is obsolete and corporate data remains siloed. Security is a paramount concern due to past data breaches Adherence to European Union (EU) data protection regulations, especially for emerging autonomous platforms, is critical. KnightMotives plans to make significant investments in fully autonomous driving capabilities, with initial implementation targeting regions with favorable regulatory environments. Prioritizing employee upskilling, attracting top-tier talent, and fostering better communication between business and technical teams are also critical objectives. question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. As part of its cloud strategy. KnightMotives wants to move its virtual machines (VMs) into Google Cloud. These VMs contain applications, database instances, and file servers. In the future, KnightMotives intends to modernize their landscape by adopting cloud native technologies on Google Cloud. During modernization, minimal latency and operational overhead between the old and new landscape will be crucial. You need to design the cloud architecture for the VM environment on Google Cloud while ensuring a future modernization track will meet the technical requirements. What should you do?

options.A: Create a Shared Virtual Private Cloud (VPC). and migrate the VMs to Compute Engine in a new project. During modernization, deploy each modernized workload in a dedicated Google Cloud project with its own VPC. Connect the two VPCs via an on-premises VPN.
options.B: Create a Shared Virtual Private Cloud (VPC). Migrate the VMs to Compute Engine in a new project. During modernization, deploy each modernized workload in a dedicated Google Cloud project using the Shared VPC.
options.C: Create a single private cloud on Google Cloud VMware Engine. Migrate the VMs using VMware HCX. During modernization, deploy the modernized workloads in a single Google Cloud project using a single VPC.
options.D: Create a single private cloud on Google Cloud VMware Engine. Migrate the VMs using VMware HCX. During modernization, deploy each modernized workload in a dedicated Google Cloud project with its own VPC. 4 Google Cloud VMware Engine

explanations.A: 错误。该选项建议通过“本地 VPN (on-premises VPN) 连接两个 VPC。这意味着云上的旧 VM 和新应用之间的流量需要回传到本地数据中心再传回云端 (Hairpinning)，这会引入巨大的延迟，且增加了对本地网络的依赖，完全违背了"最小延迟"的要求。
explanations.B: 正确。Shared VPC: ”人允许将迁移后的 VM (在服务项目中) 和未来现代化的工作负载 (在其他服务项目中) 连接到同一个共享 VPC 网络。最小延迟: 同一 VPC 内的资源 〈即使在不同项目中) 可以通过内部 IP 通信，延迟最低。运维开销: 网络管理集中化，无需配置复杂的 VPC 对等连接 (VPC Peering) 网格，且符合企业项目隔离的最佳实践。符合题意: 这是一个标准的'先迁移 (Lift & Shifb，后现代化 (Refacton "的路径，且架构灵活。5. 错误。首先，题目未明确要求使用 Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE)。虽然 GCVE 也是一种迁移路径，但通常用于必须保留 VMware RADAR. 其次，该选项建议将所有现代化的工作负载部署在单一 Google Cloud 项目中。对于大型企业 (如 KnightMotives)，将所有应用混在一个项目中违反了最小权限原则、计费分离和资源隔离的最佳实践，不利于管理和安全。D. 错误。同样，GCVE 并非题目强制要求。更重要的是，该选项建议每个现代化的工作负载都有自己的 VPC (with its own VPC)。这意味着要让旧环境和新环境通信，必须建立大量的 VPC 对等连接 (VPC Peering) 或使用 VPN/互连。随着工作负载增加，网络拓扑会变得极其复杂，管理开销巨大，且多跳网络可能增加延迟。
explanations.C: Incorrect. Migrating to Google Cloud VMware Engine keeps the workloads in a separate VMware stack, adding latency and operational overhead when interoperating with newly built cloud-native workloads; lifting the VMs to Compute Engine on a Shared VPC gives lower latency and a smoother modernization path.
explanations.D: 错误。同样，GCVE 并非题目强制要求。更重要的是，该选项建议每个现代化的工作负载都有自己的 VPC (with its own VPC)。这意味着要让旧环境和新环境通信，必须建立大量的 VPC 对等连接 (VPC Peering) 或使用 VPN/互连。随着工作负载增加，网络拓扑会变得极其复杂，管理开销巨大，且多跳网络可能增加延迟。

question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. KnightMotives management wants to upskill their engineering teams. They want each team to experiment with one specific technology at a time in a sandbox environment in Google Cloud. KnightMotives management also wants to prevent any experimental projects from going into production and creating shadow IT. They want you to design a solution that supports these training objectives and follows Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Create a request form where engineers can request a sandbox environment for a specific technology. Automate the creation of a project with only the relevant APIs enabled and lower the default API quota. Grant IAM roles related to this scope to the requesting team. Ensure the project is automatically deleted after a predefined amount of time.
options.B: Create a request form where engineers can request a sandbox environment and automate the creation of a project in which the requesting engineer obtains full permissions. Within the details of the request form, highlight the expectation of keeping costs under control and the scope limited to the requested services.
options.C: Create a separate billing account for all sandbox projects. Grant all engineers the role of Billing Account User on this billing account. Create a folder called Sandboxes in the Organization's Resource Manager. Grant all users the Project Creator role on this folder.
options.D: Create a secondary Google Cloud organization which is to be used for R&D, separate from the production organization. Create a folder for each team under this organization. Create a project for each team member in the relevant folder. Grant each team member full access to their dedicated project. Grant each team manager the permission of Security Admin on the respective folder. Have them enable the relevant APIs in each team member's project.

explanations.A: Create a request form... Automate the creation... only relevant APIs... lower default API quota... automatically deleted... (创建一个申请表.… 自动创建… 仅启用相关 API... 降低默认配额… 自动删除…) 正确。针对性强: 通过自动化脚本仅启用与申请技术相关的 AP1，严格限制了实验范围，符合'一次一种技术“的要求。防止影子 IT: “预定义时间后自动删除"是防止实验项目变成长期运行的影子 IT 的最有效技术手段。成本与安全:，降低配额限制了潜在的滥用和高额账单，同时也使得该环境在物理上不适合承载生产负载。
explanations.B: ...requesting engineer obtains full permissions... highlight the expectation... (.…申请工程师获得完全权限… 强调期望.…) 错误。依赖人治而非技防: 仅在表单中"强调期望"无法从技术上阻止工程师将项目用于生产或长期保留。权限过大:给予完全权限 (Full Permissions) 违反了最小权限原则，工程师可以开启任何服务，不符合"专注一种技术"的限制。
explanations.C: ...Grant all engineers the role of Billing Account User... Grant all users the Project Creator role... (...授予所有工程师 Billing Account User 角色.… 授予所有用户 Project Creator 角色.…) 错误。失控风险: 允许所有用户作为 Project Creator 随意创建项目，意味着他们自动成为项目的所有者 (Owner)，拥有最高权限。这无法限制技术范围，也无法强制项目生命周期。影子 IT 温床: 没有自动清理机制，这些项目很容易被遗忘并长期运行。
explanations.D: Create a secondary Google Cloud organization... question: For this question, refer to the KnightMotives Automotive case study. KnightMotives has developed and deployed a model on Vertex Al that can provide personalized recommendations in the new car configuration application. Customers will receive optional equipment recommendations that best suit their persona. Previous usage data from the car configuration application has been used for model training features. You know from past experience that customer behavior can change over time. For example, in times of economic certainty and rising stock markets, customers tend to purchase more expensive options. You want to detect when customer behavior gradually changes over time so you can adjust the model. What should you do?

options.A: Configure Model Monitoring, and select training-serving skew detection.
options.B: Configure Model Monitoring, and select prediction drift detection.
options.C: Configure Dataplex auto data quality on the prediction request data features using row-level rules.
options.D: Configure Dataplex auto data quality on the prediction request data features using aggregate rules.

explanations.A: Incorrect. Training-serving skew detection compares serving data against the training distribution to catch pipeline mismatches; it does not detect a gradual change in customer behavior over time after deployment, which is drift.
explanations.B: Configure Model Monitoring, and select prediction drift detection. 官方答案 B. Configure Model Monitoring, and select prediction drift detection. s, 结论比较我的分析与官方答案一致。题目中的关键词是“customer behavior gradually changes over time” (客户行为随时间逐渐变化)。在机器学习运维 (MLOps) 和 Vertex Al 的语境下，随时间推移的数据分布变化被称为Drift (漂移)。因此，配置 Prediction Drift Detection 是最直接且正确的解决方案。Bie So Oe ee Tih | Peeps Ree
explanations.C: Incorrect. Dataplex row-level data-quality rules validate individual records against defined constraints; they do not detect gradual statistical drift in feature distributions over time.

caseStudy: Company Overview - KnightMotives is a car manufacturer specializing in autonomous, self-driving vehicles, including Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs), hybrids and traditional internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles. While KnightMotives has made strides with the in-vehicle experience in their BEV fleet, the hybrid and ICE vehicles have yet to implement these new systems and are viewed poorly by critics and drivers. The lack of modern in-vehicle technology in hybrid and ICE vehicles has resulted in declining sales and customer satisfaction. KnightMotives wants to modernize the consumer experience across all vehicles within five years Artificial Intelligence offers a unique opportunity to revolutionize the in-vehicle experience, as well as the shopping buying and service/maintenance experience. Investment in this new technology will require a shift in financial priorities on a global scale. KnightMotives also wants to improve their online ordering system, which is unreliable. Systems for customers to build their vehicle online for acquisition through a dealer are not delivering the data or reliability that dealers need, causing. A strain in the relationship between KnightMotives and dealers. Service technicians and sales staff need better tooling to enhance dealer successes, including built-to-order vehicles. Solution Concept - KnightMotives wants to shift from manufacturing cars to creating a complete and compelling “automotive experience.” Then strategy prioritizes delivering a consistent experience across all models, developing Al-powered features, generating new revenue from data monetization, adopting a digital focus to differentiate their brand from competitors, and developing better tools for mechanics and salespeople. Existing Technical Environment - KnightMotives's IT is largely on-premises with some applications on major cloud platforms. Their supply chain runs on an outdated mainframe, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) is also outdated, making new promotions and dealer discounts difficult to implement. Dealers have no budget for new equipment. There is fragmentation across vehicles with multiple code bases, and significant technical debt from supporting backwards compatibility. Network connectivity to manufacturing plants and vehicle connectivity in rural areas are challenges. Business Requirements - Key business requirements include fostering a personalized relationship with the driver and delivering a cohesive experience across all models. Creating a better build-to-order model will reduce time on the lot and provide transparency for both dealers and customers. Additionally, KnightMotives seeks to monetize corporate data to finance new technology investments, as their current Al infrastructure is obsolete and corporate data remains siloed. Security is a paramount concern due to past data breaches Adherence to European Union (EU) data protection regulations, especially for emerging autonomous platforms, is critical. KnightMotives plans to make significant investments in fully autonomous driving capabilities, with initial implementation targeting regions with favorable regulatory environments. Prioritizing employee upskilling, attracting top-tier talent, and fostering better communication between business and technical teams are also critical objectives. Technical Requirements - * Modernizing the in-vehicle experience includes developing a consistent user experience (UX) that seamlessly integrates Al- powered features across all models, updating in-vehicle hardware and software in legacy models to support new UX features and Al capabilities, and ensuring reliable network connectivity, especially in rural areas, to support real-time Al features and data transmission. + Network upgrades are necessary to support increased data traffic and improve connectivity between plants and headquarters. + IT infrastructure modernization requires adopting a hybrid cloud strategy to leverage the benefits of both on-premises and cloud infrastructure, and gradually modernizing or replacing legacy systems to improve efficiency and agility. + Autonomous vehicle development and testing requires investing in cutting-edge Al and machine learning technologies, building a robust simulation environment, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations related to autonomous vehicles. + Data monetization and insights requires implementing a robust data management platform, strict data security and privacy measures, and a scalable AI/ML infrastructure. + Increased focus on security and risk management involves implementing a comprehensive security framework to protect against cyber threats and data breaches, developing an incident response plan, and providing security awareness training to employees. + Providing a delightful experience for dealers and customers requires improving the online build-to-order system; developing modern dealer tools to streamline dealer operations, including sales, service, and inventory management; and implementing a comprehensive Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to track customer interactions personalize experiences, and improve customer satisfaction. Executive Statement - KnightMotives is committed to enhancing safety and saving lives by leveraging an extensive body of data 一 encompassing driving, road conditions, behavioral studies, and crash safety statistics — to create compelling digital experiences for drivers. Our Al consistently outperforms national safety statistics, ensuring the unique and coveted KnightMotives experience is aligned across all our vehicle models. question: Your team plans to use Vertex Al to develop and deploy machine learning models for various use cases for fraud detection, product recommendations, and customer churn prediction. You want to enhance the security posture of the Vertex Al and Workbench environment by restricting data exfiltration. What should you do?

options.A: Enable Private Google Access for the VPC network to allow Vertex Al services to access public Google services without traversing the public internet.
options.B: Enable VPC Flow Logs to monitor network traffic to and from Vertex Al services and to identify suspicious activity.
options.C: Create a service perimeter and include ml.googleapis.com and document.googleapis.com as protected services.
options.D: Create a service perimeter and include aiplatform.googleapis.com and notebooks.googleapis.com as protected services.

explanations.A: 错误: Private Google Access 的作用是允许没有外部 IP 的 VM 访问 Google 的公共 API。虽然它确保流量不经过公共互联网，但它并不具备“防止数据泄露的功能。启用了 Private Google Access 的内部 VM 仍然可以将数据上传到组织外部的 Google Cloud 资源 (例如攻击者个人的存储桶)，除非有 VPC Service Controls 的限制。
explanations.B: 错误: VPC Flow Logs 用于记录网络流量元数据，主要用于监控、取证和故障排查。它是一种“被动"的观察工具，无法主动限制或拦截数据泄露行为。题目要求的是实施限制措施，而非仅仅监控。选项错误: 虽然创建服务边界 (Service Perimeter) 是防止数据泄露的正确手段，但此选项包含的 API 不对应题目中的服务。ml.googleapis.conm 是旧版 Al Platform (Classic) 的 API, document.googleapis.com 是 Document Al 的 APl。题目明确使用的是 Vertex Al，因此这些 API 无法保护目标环境。选项 D 正确: 本选项正确使用了 VPC Service Controls 创建服务边界，并选择了正确的 API: aiplatform.googleapis.com: 这是 Vertex Al 的核心 API 服务。notebooks.googleapis.com: 这是 Vertex Al Workbench (Managed Notebooks) 的 API 服务。将这两个服务纳入服务边界，可以强制执行上下文感知的访问控制，防止数据被复制到边界之外，完全符合题目关于“限制数据泄 WER,
explanations.C: Incorrect. ml.googleapis.com is the legacy AI Platform API and document.googleapis.com is unrelated to Vertex AI and Workbench; the service perimeter must protect aiplatform.googleapis.com and notebooks.googleapis.com to prevent data exfiltration from those services.
explanations.D: 正确: 本选项正确使用了 VPC Service Controls 创建服务边界，并选择了正确的 API: aiplatform.googleapis.com: 这是 Vertex Al 的核心 API 服务。notebooks.googleapis.com: 这是 Vertex Al Workbench (Managed Notebooks) 的 API 服务。将这两个服务纳入服务边界，可以强制执行上下文感知的访问控制，防止数据被复制到边界之外，完全符合题目关于“限制数据泄 WER,

question: You have an application that uses Vertex Al Feature Store to manage and serve product features for real-time recommendations. You want to monitor the performance and health of the application. You need to understand the overall duration of a request. What should you do?

options.A: Observe the Request size in your featurestore.
options.B: Monitor the Queries per second for your featurestore.
options.C: Measure the Latency of your requests.
options.D: Track the Online serving throughput of your requests.

explanations.A: Observe the Request size in your featurestore. (观察特征存储中的请求大小) - 错误 RA (Request size) 测量的是数据包的字节数 (Bytes)。虽然请求大小可能会影响处理时间 (大请求通常处理得更慢)，但它本身不是时间度量，无法直接告诉你请求花费了多长时间。
explanations.B: Monitor the Queries per second for your featurestore. 监控特征存储的每秒查询数) - 错误每秒查询数 (QPS) 是衡量系统负载或流量的指标。它告诉你系统有多忙，但不能告诉你每个单独的请求处理得有多快。高 QPS 可能会导致高延迟，但 QPS 本身不是持续时间。
explanations.C: Measure the Latency of your requests. (测量请求的延迟) - 正确延迟 (Latency) 的定义就是处理一个请求所需的时间 (Duration)。在 Vertex Al Feature Store 的 Cloud Monitoring 指标中，server_latency 正是用来衡量在线服务请求处理时长的。这是直接回答题目"overall duration Ast.
explanations.D: Track the Online serving throughput of your requests. (跟踪请求的在线服务吞吐量) - 错误吞吐量 (Throughput) 通常指单位时间内处理的数据量 (如 MB/s) 或请求完成的速率。虽然它与性能有关，但它侧重于系统的处理能力 (Capacity)，而不是单个请求的具体耗时 (Duration)。

question: A large healthcare provider's primary electronic health record (EHR) application runs on Compute Engine instances with a Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL database, all located in the us-west1 region. A new regulatory mandate requires you to implement and document a business continuity plan (BCP). This plan must ensure that the EHR application can be fully recovered and operational in a different geographical region with a recovery time objective (RTO) of two hours and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 15 minutes. You need to design a disaster recovery strategy that meets these strict BCP requirements. What should you do?

options.A: Deploy active managed instance groups (MIGs) in both us-west1 and us-east1, fronted by a global external HTTP(S) Load Balancer. For the database, use a cross-region read replica in us-east1, and rely on load balancer health checks to automatically fail over all traffic during an outage.
options.B: Use Terraform to define the application's compute infrastructure. During a disaster, configure the Cloud SQL database in us- west1 to use a cross-region read replica in us-east1, build the environment in us-east1, and promote the replica.
options.C: Take daily snapshots of the Compute Engine disks and Cloud SQL database. Copy these snapshots to a Cloud Storage bucket in us-east1. During a disaster, manually restore the virtual machines (VMs) and database from the latest snapshots
options.D: Deploy a regional MIG in us-west1 for high availability, and rely on the Google Cloud SLA to ensure the region remains online.

explanations.A: (正确) : 架构: 在两个区域部署应用 (MIGs) 并使用全球负载均衡器，数据库使用跨区域只读副本。RPO 分析: Cloud SQL 的跨区域只读副本使用异步复制，通党延迟在几秒到几分钟之间，完全满足 15分钟的 RPO 要求。RIO Sit: 应用服务器已经在备用区域部署 (或者是热备/温备状态)，负载均衡器可以快速切换流量。数据库副本提升为主实例的时间通常在几分钟内，远小于 2小时的 RTO, 结论: 这是最符合 RTO 和 RPO 要求的方案。昌然 Cloud SQL 的故障转移通常需要手动提升副本 (除非使用特定的自动化脚本或企业版高级功能)，但题目强调的是架构设计是否能够满足 BCP 要求，此架构完全具备能力。
explanations.B: (错误) : 逻辑漏洞: 选项提到'在灾难期间 (During a disasten，配置 us-west1 的数据库使用跨区域副本“。这是不可能的。如果 us-west1 已经发生灾难 (例如区域完全离线)，你无法连接到主数据库来创建新的副本。副本必须在灾难发生之前就已经建立并持续同步，才能满足 RPO。RPO 风险: 即使主数据库在灾难时还能勉强读取，临时创建副本并同步数据的时间极长，无法保证 RPO. 选项 (错误) : RPO 不达标: 选项建议“每日快照" Daily snapshots)。这意味着如果灾难发生在快照生成后的第 23 小时，你将丢失 23 小时的数据。这对应的 RPO 是 24 小时，远超题目要求的 15 分钟。选项 D (BIR): 不满足合规性: 题目明确要求"必须确保应用程序可以在不同的地理区域完全恢复"。选项 D 仅在 us-west1 部署区域性 MIG, EBA 提高了单区域的高可用性，但无法应对整个区域瘫痪的灾难，不符合跨区域容灾的强制要求。我的选择 A EASE A 对比与总结我的选择与官方答案一致。此题的关键在于识别 RPO (数据新鲜度) 的要求。15分钟的 RPO 实际上排除了基于备份/快照的恢复方案 (通常用于 RPO 为数小时或数天的场景)，强制要求使用数据库复制技术 (Replication)。同时，选项 B 存在严重的逻辑错误 (灾难发生后才去建立复制关系)，因此 A 是唯一技术上可行且满足业务指标的方案。a Seve Oe 上
explanations.C: Incorrect. Daily snapshots give a recovery point objective of up to 24 hours and manual restore is slow, so this cannot meet the 15-minute RPO and two-hour RTO; cross-region replication with automated failover is required.
explanations.D: (BIR): 不满足合规性: 题目明确要求"必须确保应用程序可以在不同的地理区域完全恢复"。选项 D 仅在 us-west1 部署区域性 MIG, EBA 提高了单区域的高可用性，但无法应对整个区域瘫痪的灾难，不符合跨区域容灾的强制要求。我的选择 A EASE A 对比与总结我的选择与官方答案一致。此题的关键在于识别 RPO (数据新鲜度) 的要求。15分钟的 RPO 实际上排除了基于备份/快照的恢复方案 (通常用于 RPO 为数小时或数天的场景)，强制要求使用数据库复制技术 (Replication)。同时，选项 B 存在严重的逻辑错误 (灾难发生后才去建立复制关系)，因此 A 是唯一技术上可行且满足业务指标的方案。a Seve Oe 上

question: A financial services company is decommissioning one of its on-premises data centers. As part of this initiative, the company needs to perform a one-time migration of 500 TB of historical transaction archives to a Cloud Storage bucket for long-term retention. The data center's internet egress is 1 Gbps, which is shared with critical business operations. You must complete the secure data transfer within a 60-day window to meet the decommissioning deadline. What should you do?

options.A: Provision a Partner Interconnect connection with a 10 Gbps capacity to accelerate the data transfer, and then use Storage Transfer Service.
options.B: Write a script that uses the gcloud storage cp --parallel command to upload the data in chunks over the public internet during off-peak hours.
options.C: Use Storage Transfer Service to create an agent-based transfer job that moves the data from the on-premises file servers directly to the Cloud Storage bucket.
options.D: Order a Transfer Appliance, copy the data to the appliance using your high-speed local network, and ship it back to Google to upload the data into your Cloud Storage bucket.

explanations.A: 配置一个容量为 10 Gbps 的 Partner Interconnect 连接以加速数据传输，然后使用 Storage Transfer Service, 错误。虽然 10 Gbps 的速度足以在几天内完成传输，但配置 Partner Interconnect 涉及到物理线路的铺设、服务商的协调以及 Google 侧的配置，通常需要数周甚至数月的时间 (Lead time)。对于一个正在退役的数据中心进行'一次性迁移，建立昂贵的长期物理专线既不经济，在时间上也可能来不及“(算上交付时间)。
explanations.B: 编写一个脚本，使用 gcloud storage cp --parallel 命令在非高峰时段通过公共互联网分块上传数据。错误。这是一个基于网络的传输方案。如前所述，即使全天候占用 1 Gbps 带宽也需要 46 天。如果限制在'非高峰时段”(例如每天 8-12 小时)，传输时间将延长 2 到 3 倍，远远超过 60 天的截止日期。此外，脚本管理的可靠性不如专业迁移服务。
explanations.C: 使用 Storage Transfer Service 创建一个基于代理的传输作业，将数据从本地文件服务器直接移动到 Cloud Storage 存储桶。错误。Storage Transfer Service (STS) 是一个很好的工具，但它仍然受限于物理链路的带宽。STS 无法突破 1 Gbps 共享带宽的物理瓶颈。在带宽受限目不稳定的情况下，仅靠软件层面的优化无法保证在 60 天内完成 500 TB 的数据传输。
explanations.D: 订购一台 Transfer Appliance，使用您的高速本地网络将数据复制到该设备，然后将其寄回给 Google 以将数据上传到您的 Cloud Storage 存储桶中。正确。Transfer Appliance 是专门为带宽受限、数据量大 (通常超过 20TB 或传输时间超过一周) 的场景设计的离线迁移方案。速度: 使用本地高速网络 (通常 10Gbps 或更高) 将数据复制到设备非常快。流程: 订购和运输 (几天) + 本地拷贝 (几天) + 运回 Google (几天) + Google 上传 (几天)。整个周期通常在 2-3 周内，完全符合 60 天的要求。安全性与影响: 数据是加密存储的，且不占用原本紧张的 1 Gbps 互联网出口带宽，不会影响关键业务操作。我的选择 D BASE D 结论比较我的选择与官方答案一致。在带宽受限 (1 Gbps 共享) 上且数据量巨大 (500 TB) 的情况下，物理传输设备 (Transfer Appliance) 是唯一能确保在 60 天期限内完成迁移上且不影响现有业务的可靠方案。二，，2

question: Your company wants to optimize Google Cloud costs fortheir development and staging environments. These environments are workstations used by developers Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time. Currently, the environments run ona fleet of nl-standard-4 Compute Engine instances that operate 24/7, leading to a high monthly cost for resources that are idle more than 70% of the time. You need to implement a solution that significantly reduces the monthly cost of these non-production environments without impacting the development team's productivity during work hours. What should you do?

options.A: Schedule the virtual machines to start and stop to match your team's work schedule.
options.B: Purchase three-year committed use discounts (CUDs) for the existing nl-standard-4 instances.
options.C: Upgrade all instances to the N2 machine series.
options.D: Re-architect the environments to run on a regional managed instance group (MIG) with autoscaling enabled.

explanations.A: Schedule the virtual machines to start and stop to match your team’s work schedule. (安排虚拟机根据团队的工作时间表启动和停止。) 正确。这是针对开发/测试环境最标准的成本优化策略。Google Cloud 提供了“Instance Schedule” 功能，可以自动执行此操作。停止实例后，不再收取 vCPU 和内存费用 (只收取磁盘存储费)。既然闲置时间超过 70%，关机能直接节省这部分的计算成本，且完全符合团队的工作时间，不影响生产力。
explanations.B: Purchase three-year committed use discounts (CUDs) for the existing nl-standard-4 instances. (为现有的 nl-standard-4 实例购买三年承诺使用折扣 (CUD), ) 错误。CUD 适用于 24/7 持续运行的稳定负载。虽然 3 年 CUD 能提供大幅折扣 (例如 50%-57%)，但你需要为 100% 的时间付费。比较一下: 方案 A: 按需价格支付 ~27% 的时间。方案 B: 折扣价格支付 100% 的时间。显然，只支付 27% 的时间比支付打折后的全天费用更便宜。此外，为开发环境锁定 3 年承诺缺乏灵活性。
explanations.C: Upgrade all instances to the N2 machine series. (将所有实例升级到 N2 机器系列。) 错误。升级机器系列通常是为了提升性能，而不是降低成本。N2 系列通常比 N1 系列稍贵或价格相当，但这并没有解决"资源在 70% 的时间内闲置"这个根本问题。这反而可能增加成本。
explanations.D: Re-architect the environments to run on a regional managed instance group (MIG) with autoscaling enabled. (重新架构环境，使其运行在启用了自动扩缩容功能的区域托管实例组 (MIG) 上。) 错误。1. 适用性差: 开发工作站通常是有状态的”(Stateful)，保存着开发者的代码、配置和会话。MIG 和自动扩缩容通常用于"无状态”(Stateless) 的应用。如果自动缩容因为 CPU 利用率低而删除了实例，开发者未保存的工作可能会丢失。2. 过度工程: 重新架构环境极其复杂上且昂贵，对于仅仅是想在下班时间省钱的需求来说，属于杀鸡用牛刀。

question: A retail company s most critical application is its online payment processing system. The business has a requirement that the system must be able to survive a complete zonal outage while minimizing cost. You need a design solution that can handle a zonal failure. What should you do?

options.A: Deploy the application in an active-active configuration using managed instance groups (MIGs) in two different regions, fronted by a global external HTTP(S) Load Balancer and backed by a multi-regional database like Spanner.
options.B: Deploy the application on a regional MIG to provide high availability across multiple zones in the primary region.
options.C: Configure the regional MIG to use only Spot VMs to aggressively minimize operational costs while maintaining high availability.
options.D: Deploy the application on Compute Engine instances across multiple regions and rely on daily snapshots for recovery to achieve the lowest possible cost.

explanations.A: (错误) : 此方案建议跨两个不同的 Region 进行部署并使用 Spanner。昌然这提供了极高的可用性 〈可以抵御 Region 级别的故障)，但题目仅要求抵御 Zone 级别的故障。跨 Region 部署涉及更高的计算成本、复杂的网络配置以及昂贵的跨 Region 数据传输费，spanner 的多地区配置也比普通数据库昂贵。这属于过度设计，不符合"最小化成本"的要求。
explanations.B: (正确): 区域性托管实例组 (Regional MIG) 允许你在同一个 Region 内的多个 Zone (通常是 3 个) 之间分布 VM 实例。如果一个 Zone 宕机，流量会被路由到其他 Zone 的健康实例，且 MIG 会自动维持实例数量。这直接解决了 Zone 级故障的问题，且相比跨 Region 方案，它没有额外的跨 Region 流量费，管理也更简单，是满足需求且成本最低的 HA 方案。
explanations.C: (错误): 虽然 Spot VM (抢占式实例) 确实能大幅降低成本，但它们随时可能被 Google Cloud 回收。对于'最关键"的'在线支付系统"来说，稳定性至关重要。仅使用 Spot VM 会导致极高的服务中断风险，这违背了关键应用的基本可用性原则。通常 Spot VM 用于无状态、容错性强的批处理任务，而非核心支付系统。
explanations.D: (错误) : 依赖每日快照"进行恢复意味着在灾难发生时，你可能会丢失长达 24 小时的数据 (RPO = 24小时)。对于在线支付系统而言，这是完全不可接受的。此外，从快照恢复需要时间 (RTO 高)，无法做到在 Zone 中断时让系统"生存"下来 〈即保持在线)。我的答案 B 官方答案 B 答案比较与结论我的分析与官方答案完全一致。原因重述: Regional MIG 是 Google Cloud 提供的标准解决方案，用于在单个 Region 内实现跨 Zone 的高可用性。它精准地覆盖了题目要求的故障域 (Zone failure)，同时避免了跨 Region 架构带来的额外高昂成本。二，a 5

question: Your company is a global financial services provider that processes and analyzes a high volume of credit card transactions in real time for fraud detection. Your analytics team must run complex batch queries on the same transaction data for daily reporting. You need to design a data processing solution that can handle both real-time and batch processing of the transaction data while minimizing operational overhead and infrastructure management. What should you do?

options.A: Use Dataprep to ingest the transactions.
options.B: Use Dataflow to process the streaming data.
options.C: Use a Dataproc cluster for both the streaming and batch workloads.
options.D: Use BigQuery for the batch analytics reports.
options.E: Use Firestore to store and analyze the transaction data.

explanations.A: Use Dataprep to ingest the transactions. (使用 Dataprep 摄取交易数据。) 错误。Dataprep (Cloud Dataprep by Trifacta) 主要用于可视化的数据清洗和准备，它不是为了高吞吐量的实时数据“摄取"或复杂的流式事件处理而设计的。摄取通常使用 Pub/Sub，处理使用 Dataflow。
explanations.B: Use Dataflow to process the streaming data. (使用 Dataflow 处理流式数据。) 正确。Dataflow Google Cloud 上用于执行 Apache Beam 管道的全托管服务。它能够以统一的编程模型处理流式 (SEAT) 和批量数据。对于实时欺诈检测，Dataflow 可以进行窗口计算、模式匹配等操作。它是 Serverless 的，完全符合"最小化运维开销"的要
explanations.C: Use a Dataproc cluster for both the streaming and batch workloads. (使用 Dataproc 集群同时处理流式和批处理工作负载。) 错误。虽然 Dataproc (托管的 sparwWHadoop) 可以通过 Spark Streaming 处理流数据，也可以处理批处理，但它基于集群 (Cluster-based)。这意味着你需要管理集群的大小、扩缩容策略、版本更新等，相比于 Dataflow 的全托管 Serverless 模式，Dataproc 的运维开销 (Operational Overhead) 更高，不符合题目中"最小化运维"的要求。
explanations.D: Use BigQuery for the batch analytics reports. (使用 BigQuery 进行批量分析报告。) 正确。BigQuery 是 serverless 的企业级数据仓库，专为大规模数据的复杂 SQL 查询和分析而设计。题目要求"对交易数据运行复杂的批量查询以进行每日报告"，这正是 BigQuery 的核心用例。它无需管理基础设施，运维开销极低。
explanations.E: Use Firestore to store and analyze the transaction data. (使用 Firestore 存储和分析交易数据。) 错误。Firestore 是一个 NoSQL 文档数据库，主要用于移动端和 Web 应用的后端 (OLTP 场景)。虽然它可以扩展，但它不适合运行全表扫描或复杂的聚合分析查询 (OLAP 场景)。在 Firestore 上进行大规模数据的"复杂批量查询"效率低且成本高。

question: Your company uses a custom-built application running on a Compute Engine virtual machine (VM). This application processes real-time sales data and writes it to a zonal Persistent Disk. A recent internal audit requires that you implement a backup and recovery plan to protect against zonal failures. Your company has a strict policy that all backup data must be retained for at least 90 days and stored in a separate project with limited access. You need to implement a fully automated backup solution that meets these requirements with minimal operational overhead. What should you do?

options.A: Write a script to create daily backups of the Persistent Disk. Copy the backups to a different zone and apply a label to each snapshot to indicate the deletion date.
options.B: Use gcloud commands to create snapshots of the Persistent Disk. Store the snapshots in a regional Cloud Storage bucket and configure a lifecycle rule to delete objects older than 90 days.
options.C: Create a snapshot schedule to automatically create Persistent Disk snapshots and use a script to move and store them ina multi-regional Cloud Storage bucket.
options.D: Use the Backup and Disaster Recovery (DR) service to create a backup plan. Configure the backup plan to take daily snapshots and store them in a backup vault with a 90-day retention policy.

explanations.A: 编写脚本来创建永久磁盘的每日备份… 错误。虽然编写脚本可以实现功能，但这违反了"最小化运维开销 (minimal operational overhead) “的要求。脚本需要维护、监控和定期更新。此外，手动管理跨区域复制和基于标签的删除逻辑非常繁琐且容易出错。
explanations.B: 使用 gcloud 命令创建快照… 存储在区域性 Cloud Storage 存储桶中.… 错误。首先，Compute Engine 的快照 (Snapshots) 是存储在 Google 管理的存储系统中，用户不能直接像操作普通文件一样将其'存储'在自己创建的 Cloud Storage Bucket 中 (除非执行导出操作，但这通常用于镜像而非增量备份)。其次，单纯使用 gcloud 命令不是“全自动"的，需要配合 Cron Job 或其他调度工具，增加了运维负担。选项 5: 创建快照计划… 并使用脚本将其移动并存储在多区域 Cloud Storage 存储桶中。错误。“快照计划 (Snapshot Schedule) “本身是一个很好的原生功能，可以自动创建快照。但是，题目要求将备份存储在单独的项目 (separate project) “中。标准的快照计划通常将快照保留在源项目或源磁盘关联的位置。虽然可以通过脚本复制快照到另一个项目，但这引入了自定义脚本的维护成本 (High Overhead)。此外，像选项B一样，快照并不直接作为对象存储在 Bucket 中供用户随意移动。选项 D: 使用备份和灾难恢复 (DR) 服务创建备份计划。配置备份计划以进行每日快照，并将其存储在具有 90 天保留策略的备份保管库中。正确。Google Cloud Backup and DR Service 是专门为此类企业级需求设计的全托管服务。自动化与保留策略: 它允许定义包含频率和保留期 (如90天) 的备份计划 (Backup Plan)。隔离性与安全性: 它使用“备份保管库 (Backup Vault) “的概念，可以轻松配置将备份数据存储在与源项目隔离的单独项目中，满足审计和安全要求。运维开销: 作为托管服务，它消除了编写和维护脚本的需求，符合'最小化运维开销"的要求。灾难恢复: 它天然支持应对区域性故障的恢复场景。我的选择 D 官方答案 D 结论对比我的选择与官方答案一致。RABE: ”题目中的关键词是"单独的项目 (separate project) “、"全自动 (fully automated) “和"最小化运维开销 (minimal operational overhead) “。昌然快照计划 (Snapshot Schedule) 可以自动化备份，但要满足跨项目存储和集中管理的合规性要求，Backup and DR Service 是最原生、最符合企业级管理上且运维成本最低的解决方案。它通过 Backup Vault 机制完美解决了数据隔离和生命周期管理的问题。二，，2
explanations.C: Incorrect. Persistent Disk snapshots cannot simply be moved into a Cloud Storage bucket, and the custom script adds operational overhead and does not provide the isolated backup vault with enforced 90-day retention in a separate project that Backup and DR delivers.
explanations.D: 使用备份和灾难恢复 (DR) 服务创建备份计划。配置备份计划以进行每日快照，并将其存储在具有 90 天保留策略的备份保管库中。正确。Google Cloud Backup and DR Service 是专门为此类企业级需求设计的全托管服务。自动化与保留策略: 它允许定义包含频率和保留期 (如90天) 的备份计划 (Backup Plan)。隔离性与安全性: 它使用“备份保管库 (Backup Vault) “的概念，可以轻松配置将备份数据存储在与源项目隔离的单独项目中，满足审计和安全要求。运维开销: 作为托管服务，它消除了编写和维护脚本的需求，符合'最小化运维开销"的要求。灾难恢复: 它天然支持应对区域性故障的恢复场景。我的选择 D 官方答案 D 结论对比我的选择与官方答案一致。RABE: ”题目中的关键词是"单独的项目 (separate project) “、"全自动 (fully automated) “和"最小化运维开销 (minimal operational overhead) “。昌然快照计划 (Snapshot Schedule) 可以自动化备份，但要满足跨项目存储和集中管理的合规性要求，Backup and DR Service 是最原生、最符合企业级管理上且运维成本最低的解决方案。它通过 Backup Vault 机制完美解决了数据隔离和生命周期管理的问题。二，，2

question: Your ecommerce web application includes many products with pictures and videos. You need to improve the application's page load speed and reduce the latency for customer requests. What should you do? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy your application to Cloud Run and enable concurrency.
options.B: Use Memorystore tor Redis.
options.C: Implement CDN with the application's external HTTPS load balancer.
options.D: Change the database from Bigtable to Spanner.
options.E: Deploy your application to a GKE Autopilot cluster instead of a regular GKE cluster.

explanations.A: Deploy your application to Cloud Run and enable concurrency. (将您的应用程序部署到 Cloud Run 并启用并发。) - 错误虽然 Cloud Run 是一个优秀的无服务器计算平台，且并发 (Concurrency) 允许每个实例处理多个请求，但这主要解决的是计算资源的利用率和自动扩缩容问题。它不能直接解决静态资源 (图片、视频) 的传输延迟问题，也不是减少数据库查询延迟的首选方法。
explanations.B: Use Memorystore for Redis. (使用 Memorystore for Redis。) - 正确电商应用通常有大量的读请求 (如查看产品详情、价格、库存)。使用 Memorystore for Redis 可以将这些频繁读取的数据缓存在内存中，从而避免每次都去查询后端数据库。这能显著降低应用程序的响应时间 (Latency) 并提高页面加载速度。
explanations.C: Implement CDN with the application's external HTTPS load balancer. (在应用程序的外部 HTTPS 负载均衡器上实施 CDN。) - 正确题目明确提到应用包含许多“图片和视频"。Ccloud CON 是解决此类静态资源加载速度的最佳方案。它将内容缓存在离用户最近的 Google 边缘节点上，极大地减少了网络传输延迟 (RTT)，是提升全球用户页面加载速度的最直接手段。
explanations.D: Change the database from Bigtable to Spanner (将数据库从 Bigtable 更改为 Spanner。) - 错误 Bigtable 本身就是为高吞吐量和低延迟设计的(通常用于分析或大规模数据)。Spanner 是强一致性的全球数据库。虽和然 Spanner 很强大，但仅仅更换数据库引丈通常涉及重大的架构重构，且不一定能比 Bigtable 更快地解决"页面加载速度问题，特别是针对媒体文件，数据库选型并非瓶颈所在。
explanations.E: Deploy your application to a GKE Autopilot cluster instead of a regular GKE cluster. (将您的应用程序部署到 GKE Autopilot 集群，而不是常规 GKE 集群。) - 错误 GKE Autopilot 主要简化了集群的管理和运维 (由 Google 管理节点)，它并不直接提升应用程序对最终用户的响应速度或网络延迟。这属于运维优化，而非性能优化。

question: You need to build and deploy a containerized web application to Google Cloud. The application is very write-heavy and requires a relational database as its data store. The application needs to be highly available in multiple cloud regions. You want to minimize operational overhead while following Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Deploy the application to GKE clusters in multiple regions and expose the application endpoint with a regional load balancer. Use Cloud SQL as the database.
options.B: Deploy the application to Cloud Run in multiple regions behind a global HTTPS load balancer. Use Spanner as the database.
options.C: Deploy the application to a GKE standard cluster behind a global HTTPS load balancer. Use Firestore as the database with multi-region locations enabled.
options.D: Deploy the application to a GKE standard cluster with a global ingress to expose the application endpoint. Use Bigtable as the database.

explanations.A: 分析: 错误。虽然 GKE 可以运行容器，但题目要求"最小化运维开销 (minimize operational overhead)", Cloud Run LY GKE 更符合这一要更关键的是数据库选择: Cloud SQL 虽然是关系型数据库，但它通常是单区域写入 (Single Writer)，在多区域高写入 (Write- heavy) 场景下，跨区域同步和故障转移的复杂性较高，且难以实现真正的多区域同时高并发写入。使用"区域负载均衡器"无法直接提供全球统一的入口，不符合多区域高可用的最佳实践 (通常应使用全球负载均衡器)。
explanations.B: 分析: 正确。Cloud Run 是全托管的 serverless 容器平台，完全符合"最小化运维开销"的要求。全球 HTTPS 负载均衡器可以将流量智能路由到最近的可用区域，实现多区域高可用。Cloud Spanner Google Cloud 提供的全球分布式关系型数据库，专为大规模、高可用性 (99.999%) 和跨区域强一致性设计。它完美契合"关系型数据库“`、'高写入负载"以及“多区域高可用"的需求。
explanations.C: 分析: 错误。题目明确要求使用"关系型数据库 (relational database)"。Firestore 是 NoSQL 文档数据库，不符合数据模型要求。此外，GKE Standard 集群的运维开销高于 Cloud Run,
